newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Chinese Bank places HK$75 million FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Chinese Bank places HK$75 million FRCD.

text.p: The Hongkong Chinese Bank has lodged a HK$75 million negotiable floating rate certificate of deposit issue due August 4, 1997, with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority Central Moneymarkets Unit.
The issue was priced at par and pays a coupon of 30 basis points over the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Chase Manhattan Asia was the arranger and the paying agent.
Hongkong Chinese Bank is 50 percent held by HKCB Bank Holding Co Ltd and 50 percent by China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
